title: Add GET /api/codex/issues/{id}/budget endpoint
description: Add a new read endpoint `GET /api/codex/issues/{id}/budget` to the FastAPI backend. The endpoint must reuse `compute_issue_budget_status` from `app.application.budget_service` so the value matches the conductor's gating number (not the `/cost-stats` log-scan number). Response is the JSON serialization of `IssueBudgetStatus` with the fields: `issue_id`, `spent_usd`, `budget_usd`, `remaining_usd` (number or null), `used_ratio` (number or null), `soft_warn` (bool), `over_budget` (bool), `soft_warn_ratio` (number), `has_ceiling` (bool), `budget_source` ('issue' | 'default'). Returns 404 when the issue does not exist and 503 when the store is not available.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/codex/issues/{id}/budget returns IssueBudgetStatus JSON for an existing issue
Endpoint returns 404 when the issue does not exist
remaining_usd and used_ratio are null when has_ceiling is false

argv: from fastapi import FastAPI; from fastapi.testclient import TestClient; from app.interfaces.api import router; app = FastAPI(); app.include_router(router); r = TestClient(app).get('/api/codex/issues/does-not-exist/budget'); assert r.status_code == 404, r.text

from app.application.budget_service import IssueBudgetStatus; s = IssueBudgetStatus(issue_id='i', spent_usd=1.0, budget_usd=2.0, budget_source='issue', soft_warn_ratio=0.8); d = s.to_dict(); assert set(d.keys()) == {'issue_id','spent_usd','budget_usd','remaining_usd','used_ratio','soft_warn','over_budget','soft_warn_ratio','has_ceiling','budget_source'}; assert d['has_ceiling'] is True; assert d['remaining_usd'] == 1.0; assert d['used_ratio'] == 0.5
pinned_qa_commands.description: Sanity-check the to_dict() shape (does not require a live server)

notes: Field shape is pinned by the IssueBudgetStatus.to_dict() contract; coverage scorer is sensitive to the exact field names.
